title: Stage E controlled hydration, content pressure and mutable-state rechecks
comparison: Three rotated trials per baseline/candidate cell; all samples retained, no outlier exclusion.

provenance.candidate_description: Stage E reviewed frozen working tree on candidate base, not the base commit alone.
provenance.source_hash_contract: Actual reviewed frozen working-tree files at report compaction; file hashes are not independent attestation of binary build inputs.

interpretation: These are controlled local actual-FUSE workloads, not network-speed, GitHub-clone or Bazel/RBE build comparisons.
The shared content cache uses anonymous disk-backed files with a 67108864-byte logical budget. This budget is not a resident-memory allocation or RSS allowance.
Reply admission has a separate 67108864-byte bound. Final Content state is reported after workers join, and all outstanding charges and queues must be zero.
Overlay allocated st_blocks exclude anonymous content-cache files. Logical shared-cache bytes and physical overlay storage are reported separately.
RSS samples cover the VFS PID only, excluding native-Git child processes and cgroup/page-cache totals. The 20ms observed oversize peak is not an absolute maximum.

Content pressure uses 20 distinct 4MiB blobs plus one 80MiB blob. Sequential 4KiB direct reads traverse forward/reverse/forward, then one oversized tail range. No overload or parallel-request throughput claim.

Baseline demand cancellation remains a known failure: measurements are censored at the 5s budget, followed by exact pidfd wrapper cleanup. A completed measurement cell is not a passed baseline cancellation.
Candidate cancellation includes daemon, blocked reader and full native-process group termination within the budget, with no forced cleanup. Zombies and remaining descendants do not count as gone.
Successful prefetch cells require coalescing; promotion may be zero for an already-active RPC. Cancellation need not show coalescing because kernel read state does not prove scheduler admission.
Three-sample min/median/max and endpoint trial indices are reported. No statistical outlier classification or discarded sample is justified by this sample size.

Raw artifacts and full operation traces remain local under logical artifact names; SHA256 commitments below bind their exact results files. No private absolute paths, PIDs, raw argv or namespaces are published.

known_prior_failure.reason: Baseline legacy demand wrapper survived daemon exit; original harness treated required pidfd cleanup as a failed cell. Preserved, not retried in place.
